newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux sees stronger Q4 in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux sees stronger Q4 in Europe.

text.p: Swedish white goods maker Electrolux said it had been surprised by a four percent fall in the European white goods market in third quarter 1996 but that it expects a recovery in the final quarter.
Electrolux Chairman Leif Johansson told reporters the company had expected a stagnant market.

"The strength of the downturn for white goods in Europe surprised us. We had expected a stagnant market. Ahead of the fourth quarter we estimate that low interest rates and the general climate will contribute to an upturn, although it will not be rapid during this quarter," Johansson said.
The downturn in Q3 was most noticeable in Germany, Spain, Italy, France and Britain. He said an inferior product mix in Europe had influenced the operating profit.
"People are buying more low price goods," he added.
